tile_scheme.assignment: centre of source geometry bounding box; no geometry simplification or coordinate transformation

format: gzip-compressed newline-delimited GeoJSON Features; one feature per line

height_policy.osm_height: parsed from explicit OSM height tag; units assumed metres unless suffix indicates metres
height_policy.levels_estimate: building levels multiplied by 3 m; approximate, not surveyed
height_policy.unknown: no usable height tag; do not silently invent a height

Jordan.warning: Game tiles use the canonical buildings layer only to prevent duplicate physical buildings from the overlapping building_details export. building_details remains available separately in the source layers.

Palestine.warning: Game tiles use the canonical buildings layer only to prevent duplicate physical buildings from the overlapping building_details export. building_details remains available separately in the source layers.
